# Relationship

Spousal/partnership relationship. N-partner support (no structural two-partner limit). Event-based timeline (status derived from events). No gendered role names. Financial instruments with MAHR/KETUBAH subtype validation. Cross-jurisdiction recognition for dual civil/religious status

Source: [`v3/relationship.json`](../../v3/relationship.json)

Schema `$id`: `https://openinherit.org/v3/relationship.json`

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` (uuid) | yes | Unique identifier for this relationship within the INHERIT document |
| `type` | one of `marriage_civil`, `marriage_religious`, `marriage_customary`, `marriage_common_law`, `civil_partnership`, `civil_union`, `domestic_partnership`, `de_facto`, `cohabitation`, `engagement` | yes | The legal form of the relationship |
| `religiousSubtype` | `string` | | The specific religious marriage form, when the type is MARRIAGE_RELIGIOUS |
| `selfDeclaredType` | `string` | | How the parties themselves describe this relationship, which may differ from the legal classification |
| `partners` | array of [Partner](#def-Partner) | yes | The people in this relationship. Minimum 2, no structural upper limit — supports polygamous marriages valid in their jurisdiction |
| `events` | array of [RelationshipEvent](#def-RelationshipEvent) | | Chronological events determining relationship status. The authoritative status should be derived from the most recent event |
| `currentStatus` | one of `active`, `separated_informal`, `separated_legal`, `divorced`, `annulled`, `dissolved`, `widowed`, `void`, `putative` | | The current status of the relationship. A convenience denormalisation — consumers should derive from the events array when available |
| `jurisdiction` | [Jurisdiction](common/jurisdiction.md) | | Primary jurisdiction where this relationship was formed or registered |
| `jurisdictionalRecognition` | array of [JurisdictionalRecognition](#def-JurisdictionalRecognition) | | How other jurisdictions recognise (or do not recognise) this relationship. Essential for cross-border estates |
| `financialInstruments` | array of [FinancialInstrument](#def-FinancialInstrument) | | Financial instruments associated with this relationship — mahr, ketubah, lobola, prenuptial agreements, etc |
| `propertyRegime` | one of `community_of_property`, `separation_of_property`, `community_of_acquests`, `deferred_community`, `separate_as_modified`, `islamic_dower`, `us_community_property`, `us_community_with_survivorship`, `us_quasi_community`, `hindu_separate` | | The marital property regime governing this relationship. Determines which assets the testator may freely dispose of |
| `notes` | `string` | | Free-text notes about this relationship |
| `provenance` | [Provenance](common/provenance.md) | | Consolidated provenance metadata — how this entity was created, by whom, and whether a human has verified it |

Also accepts properties whose names match `^x-inherit-[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,54}$`.

## Definitions

<a id="def-FinancialInstrument"></a>

### FinancialInstrument

A financial instrument associated with the relationship — mahr, ketubah, lobola, prenuptial agreement, or marriage settlement

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | one of `mahr`, `ketubah`, `lobola`, `prenuptial_agreement`, `postnuptial_agreement`, `marriage_settlement` | yes | The type of financial instrument |
| `value` | [Money](common/money.md) | | Monetary value of the instrument, in minor currency units |
| `status` | one of `agreed`, `paid`, `partially_paid`, `deferred`, `disputed`, `waived` | | Payment status of this financial instrument |
| `description` | `string` | | Free-text description of the instrument |
| `documentRef` | `string` | | Reference to a Document.id storing the instrument |
| `instrumentDate` | `string` (date) | | Date the instrument was signed or executed |
| `inheritanceImpact` | `string` | | How this instrument affects inheritance distribution |
| `maharDetails` | `object` | when `type` is `mahr` | Structured mahr details. Required when the financial instrument type is MAHR |
| `ketubahDetails` | `object` | | Structured ketubah details. Required when the financial instrument type is KETUBAH |
| `lobolaDetails` | `object` | | Structured lobola details for African customary marriages |

<a id="def-JurisdictionalRecognition"></a>

### JurisdictionalRecognition

How a specific jurisdiction recognises (or fails to recognise) this relationship. Critical for modelling civil/religious status divergence

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `jurisdiction` | [Jurisdiction](common/jurisdiction.md) | yes | The jurisdiction whose recognition status is recorded |
| `recognised` | `boolean` | yes | Whether this jurisdiction recognises the relationship |
| `recognisedAs` | `string` | | What this jurisdiction recognises the relationship as, if different from its declared type |
| `notes` | `string` | | Additional context on recognition |

<a id="def-Partner"></a>

### Partner

A partner in the relationship. Uses non-gendered terminology and ordinal positioning

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `personId` | `string` (uuid) | yes | Reference to a Person.id |
| `personIdDisplay` | `string` | | Human-readable display name for the referenced person |
| `displayLabel` | `string` | | Optional non-gendered label for display purposes. Avoids gendered terms like 'husband' and 'wife' |
| `ordinal` | `integer` | yes | Position in the partner list (1-based). Determines default display order |

<a id="def-RelationshipEvent"></a>

### RelationshipEvent

A chronological event in the relationship timeline. The current relationship status is derived from the most recent event

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | one of `ceremony`, `registration`, `engagement`, `marriage_contract`, `property_regime_change`, `separation_informal`, `separation_legal`, `divorce_filed`, `divorce_finalised`, `financial_order`, `annulment`, `dissolution`, `death_of_partner`, `reconciliation`, `void_declaration`, `mahr_payment`, `lobola_payment` | yes | The type of relationship event |
| `eventDate` | `string` (date) | yes | Date this event occurred |
| `jurisdiction` | [Jurisdiction](common/jurisdiction.md) | | Jurisdiction where this event took place or was registered |
| `notes` | `string` | | Additional context about this event |
